user.title: Connect Bonbon
user.description:
Bonbon signs in through Hrvatski Telekom SSO (Google, Apple, ...), so Home Assistant replays the session your browser already has.

1. Sign in at {portal_url} and open **Moj bonbon**
2. Open Developer tools (F12) → **Network** and filter `api4`
3. Right-click any `api4.bonbon.hr` request → **Copy** → **Copy as cURL**
4. Paste it below

The session is stored locally and renewed in the background. When it finally expires you will get a notification asking for a fresh one.

reauth_confirm.title: Bonbon session expired
reauth_confirm.description:
The session Home Assistant was using is no longer valid. Sign in at {portal_url} again, then copy an `api4.bonbon.hr` request:

Developer tools (F12) → **Network** → filter `api4` → right-click a request → **Copy** → **Copy as cURL**.

error.invalid_session: That does not look like a copied api4.bonbon.hr request. In DevTools, filter `api4` and copy one of those requests.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected this session. Sign in again in the browser and copy a fresh request.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach bonbon.hr. Check the connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from the portal. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Bonbon account is already set up.
